props.name: resource
props.comment: The resource, used to label inputs. Defaults to the resource context.

props.name: storeKey
props.comment: Where the choice is stored. Defaults to `<resource>.inputs`.

props.name: defaultHiddenInputs
props.comment: The ids (a `source`, else a `label`) hidden until the user stores a choice.

props.name: title
props.comment: The panel's title while this is selected. Defaults to "Form".
